status_meaning.COMPLETE: all pre-registered checks passed and every topology has a record for every cell of its antenna case
status_meaning.INCOMPLETE_RESOURCE: the internal wall cap stopped the run; labels are not interpreted
status_meaning.FAIL_INTEGRITY: a pre-registered integrity check failed; labels are not interpreted

interpretation_rules: Primary: per-topology MSE ratio r_t = MSE_B2(t)/MSE_B1(t). ORDER_CONFIRMED requires all three predicted signs and all three Bonferroni intervals excluding zero; effect_size_label is separate. The K5, N1 and m1=0.70 blocks are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY and are not a formal secondary ordering test. SE labels are secondary and descriptive. A c = 0, fixed or proper row with B1 != B2 is an integrity failure. A FAIL_INTEGRITY or INCOMPLETE_RESOURCE status makes every ordering/collapse/row label non-interpreted. The B2 moment check is a plumbing check, not a result.

secondary_descriptive.note: The K5, N1 and m1=0.70 blocks are reported as per-cell means and per-topology ratios. They are not part of the primary ordering test and cannot establish the claim at those settings.

draw_registry.common_random_numbers: the frame seed is shared across cells and shapes at a given (topology, realization); each shape maps the same uniform field, so the diffuse and noise draws are common random numbers
